nodes.name: auth_tool.rs
nodes.summary: McpAuthTool is a pseudo-tool surfaced in place of an unauthenticated MCP server's real tools; the LLM calls it to trigger the OAuth flow and reconnect.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command surface for the learning system: trigger reflection, list/edit/delete learnings for the Learnings Browser, and manage per-agent workspace memory files.

nodes.name: extract.rs
nodes.summary: LLM extraction prompt and response parsing for the active-observation (tool-failure pattern) learning path, producing an ActiveLearningInsight.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Active-observation L3 write path: scans a session's tool history for tool-error-then-user-intervention patterns and, if found, extracts and records a pending learning.

nodes.name: patterns.rs
nodes.summary: Pure pattern-detection over the persisted message stream: pairs tool_result errors with the next user turn to flag durable agent blind spots.

nodes.name: provider.rs
nodes.summary: Selects the LLM provider used for active-observation extraction, consulting and updating the shared reflection blacklist to avoid repeat failures.

nodes.name: blacklist.rs
nodes.summary: Persistent SQLite-backed blacklist of (account_id, model_id) pairs that previously failed L3 reflection, so future reflection attempts skip them indefinitely.

nodes.name: extract.rs
nodes.summary: LLM extraction and post-hoc rejection filtering for narrative reflection insights, guarding against environment-specific noise slipping into stored learnings.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a McpAuthTool for a server that needs OAuth, capturing the manager handle used to trigger reconnect.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Runs the OAuth flow for the target MCP server, persists credentials, and asks McpManager to reconnect so real tools reappear.

nodes.name: McpAuthTool
nodes.summary: Pseudo-tool registered as mcp__<server>__authenticate in place of an unauthenticated MCP server's real tools; implements the Tool trait.

nodes.name: to_record
nodes.summary: Converts an internal Learning row into the LearningRecord DTO returned to the frontend.

nodes.name: session_trigger_reflection
nodes.summary: Tauri command that manually triggers post-session reflection for a given session.

nodes.name: session_list_learnings
nodes.summary: Tauri command that lists active learnings for a given scope.

nodes.name: session_deprecate_learning
nodes.summary: Tauri command that manually deprecates a single learning.

nodes.name: learnings_list
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning a filtered list of learnings for the Learnings Browser list panel.

nodes.name: learnings_update_body
nodes.summary: Tauri command that edits a learning's takeaway/content fields.

nodes.name: learnings_set_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command that performs a whitelisted status transition on a learning.

nodes.name: learnings_delete
nodes.summary: Tauri command that hard-deletes a user-created learning.

nodes.name: learnings_get_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the Consolidation Status card data for the Learnings Browser.

nodes.name: build_next_trigger_hint
nodes.summary: Builds a human-readable hint describing when the next consolidation run will trigger.

nodes.name: workspace_memory_list
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing files in an agent's workspace memory directory.

nodes.name: workspace_memory_read
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading a single workspace memory file, guarding against path traversal.

nodes.name: workspace_memory_delete
nodes.summary: Tauri command deleting a single workspace memory file, guarding against path traversal.

nodes.name: workspace_memory_clear
nodes.summary: Tauri command clearing all workspace memory files for an agent.

nodes.name: workspace_memory_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command computing aggregate status (file count, size, last-updated) of an agent's workspace memory.

nodes.name: workspace_memory_write
nodes.summary: Tauri command writing/updating a workspace memory file, invalidating the prompt cache on change.

nodes.name: debug_seed_learning
nodes.summary: Debug-only Tauri command that seeds a synthetic learning row for manual UI testing.

nodes.name: debug_memory_prefetch_section
nodes.summary: Debug-only Tauri command exposing the workspace-memory prefetch-section computation.

nodes.name: LearningRecord
nodes.summary: Frontend-facing DTO for a single learning row (content, takeaway, category, status, importance/confidence, source).

nodes.name: ReflectionResult
nodes.summary: Result payload of a manually-triggered reflection run.

nodes.name: ConsolidationRunSummary
nodes.summary: Summary of a single learnings-consolidation run for the status card.

nodes.name: LearningsStatusReport
nodes.summary: Aggregate consolidation-status payload returned to the Learnings Browser.

nodes.name: WorkspaceMemoryEntry
nodes.summary: Directory-listing entry for a workspace memory file.

nodes.name: WorkspaceMemoryDetail
nodes.summary: Full detail (content + metadata) of a single workspace memory file.

nodes.name: WorkspaceMemoryStatus
nodes.summary: Aggregate status (file count, total size, last updated) of an agent's workspace memory.

nodes.name: extract_insight
nodes.summary: Calls the LLM with the active-observation prompt for a batch of tool-failure patterns and parses the response into an insight.

nodes.name: format_patterns_for_prompt
nodes.summary: Formats detected tool-failure patterns into the prompt body sent to the LLM.

nodes.name: parse_llm_response
nodes.summary: Parses the LLM's JSON response into an ActiveLearningInsight, tolerating an empty object meaning "nothing worth recording".

nodes.name: strip_code_fence
nodes.summary: Strips a surrounding markdown code fence from an LLM response before JSON parsing.

nodes.name: ActiveLearningInsight
nodes.summary: Single-insight payload returned by the active-observation prompt, distinct from the narrative-reflection ExtractedInsight.

nodes.name: maybe_observe_tool_failures
nodes.summary: Entry point for the active-observation path: gates on agent scope/opt-out/blacklist, scans for tool-failure patterns, and extracts+records a learning if the pattern threshold is met.

nodes.name: scan_patterns
nodes.summary: Queries the persisted message stream and pairs tool-error results with the following user turn to build ToolFailurePattern candidates.

nodes.name: detect_patterns
nodes.summary: Applies MIN_PATTERN_COUNT thresholding to decide whether scanned patterns are significant enough to extract.

nodes.name: looks_like_error
nodes.summary: Heuristically determines whether a tool_result message content looks like an error.

nodes.name: truncate_snippet
nodes.summary: Truncates a message snippet to a bounded length for inclusion in the LLM prompt.

nodes.name: ToolFailurePattern
nodes.summary: A single detected (tool-error, user-intervention) pair used as active-observation extraction input.

nodes.name: get_observation_provider
nodes.summary: Resolves the LLM provider for active-observation extraction, checking the shared reflection blacklist first and recording new failures.

nodes.name: init_reflection_blacklist_table
nodes.summary: Creates the SQLite reflection_blacklist table if it does not already exist.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Looks up whether an (account_id, model_id) pair is already blacklisted for reflection.

nodes.name: record
nodes.summary: Inserts a new blacklist entry for an (account_id, model_id) pair that just failed reflection.

nodes.name: extract_insights
nodes.summary: Calls the LLM with the reflection prompt for a session transcript and parses the response into a list of insights.

nodes.name: extract_json_array
nodes.summary: Extracts a JSON array from an LLM response that may be wrapped in prose or code fences.

nodes.name: rejection_reason
nodes.summary: Applies post-hoc filters to reject environment-specific noise (paths, UUIDs, etc.) from an extracted insight.

nodes.name: ExtractedInsight
nodes.summary: A single narrative reflection insight extracted from a session transcript, prior to post-hoc rejection filtering.
